newsitem.title: INDIA: India UTI's new index fund collects $30 mln.
newsitem.headline: India UTI's new index fund collects $30 mln.

text.p: India's biggest mutual fund Unit Trust of India (UTI) said on Wednesday it had received $30 million for a new index fund.
India Access Ltd, the open-ended fund incorporated in Mauritius, will invest in shares comprising the 50-stock National Stock Exchange index, the UTI said in a statement.
"The international experience of index funds is that their success after launch depends considerably on their close tracking of the market index," the statement said.
"UTI is confident of managing this index fund with minimum tracking error."
Subscription to the fund, lead managed by SBC Warburg, closed on February 7. Subscribers are largely big investors based in the U.S. and Europe, officials said.
UTI has appointed Britain's Commercial Union Investment Management Ltd as a consultant.
A UTI official said it has deployed the entire fund.
